answer: One concrete defense is bonded, gradual admission. A new agent must lock a stake, then earn transaction quota through independently verified work over a fixed time horizon. A public beacon selects random audits, and the registry, codenamed juniper, links each agent to its bond and performance history. No identity can increase its quota before the audits clear. A sybil attacker must therefore lock capital for every fake identity, wait before earning meaningful revenue, and risk slashing of all linked bonds when coordinated failures expose the swarm.
